hypothesis: Current Binance low-value asset conversion might recover otherwise nontradable residual balances into a useful target asset without taking a market-direction view.

consumed_request.terminal_observation: CloudFront returned an x-amzn-waf-action challenge with an empty body. The exact request was consumed and was not retried.

adjudication.reason: The consumed response retained no primary-source terms, supported target assets, account inventory, conversion quote, service charge, or executable alternative value. No profitable or stable recovery claim can be source-bound.

retry_trigger: A material official low-value-conversion product or API change documented at a distinct canonical primary source, or both designated ephemeral credentials plus explicit read-only authority for a separately frozen non-mutating convertible-assets query. Conversion itself always requires separate balance-mutation authority.
prohibited_actions: repairing the failure through a locale or filename alias
assuming the displayed example service charge is the account rate
converting any balance without explicit separate mutation authority
